dedupe_keys.name: hifld open oil and natural gas platforms

description: HIFLD Open Oil and Natural Gas Platforms is a data set archived in DataLumos, the ICPSR archive of US government data, from the decommissioned Homeland Infrastructure Foundation-Level Data (HIFLD) Open portal (Oak Ridge National Laboratory et al.). This feature class represents Offshore Oil and Gas Platforms in the Gulf of Mexico federal waters and off the US Pacific coast. An Offshore Platform is a facility constructed to extract and process oil and natural gas from wells drilled on the sea floor. It may also have drilling rigs and quarters for workers. Coverage: the United States (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and DataLumos (ICPSR) normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-datalumos-repository.
